title: Sea lions raise their young at Farallon Island National Wildlife Refuge (54230469923).jpg
author: USFWS Pacific Southwest Region
credit: Sea lions raise their young at Farallon Island National Wildlife Refuge
description: The Farallon Islands National Wildlife Refuge is located on the pacific coast approximately 28 miles west of San Francisco California. Totaling 211 acres, it is composed of several islands in four groups: the North Farallon, Middle Farallon, South Farallon Islands, and Noonday Rock. Photo by Joanna Gilkeson/USFWS
